definition.simple: Everything natural you can see in the sky, like the sun, moon, and stars.
definition.academic: Naturally occurring physical entities, associations, or structures that exist in the observable universe.

common_misconceptions: Satellites made by humans are celestial objects (They are not natural).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to look out the window at night and list 3 things they see that weren't made by humans.
